titulo_fr: Une brève locale : Repérer les informations
titulo_es: A brief local news: Find data
intro: It extracts what happened, where and when of a local news. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It extracts what happened, where and when of a local news. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
The point of attention: The common passé presents the event; the imparfait can describe the context that was already in progress. In this fragment, «quartier» means «neighborhood».

frases.fr: La mairie a ouvert un nouvel espace vert dans le quartier Saint-Roch samedi dernier.
frases.es: El ayuntamiento abrió un nuevo espacio verde en el barrio de Saint-Roch el sábado pasado.
frases.en: The town hall opened a new green space in the Saint- Roch district last Saturday.

frases.fr: Les travaux ont duré six mois et ont coûté moins cher que prévu.
frases.es: Las obras duraron seis meses y costaron menos de lo previsto.
frases.en: The work lasted six months and cost less than expected.
